description: Get the zones (rooms) of a level: name, colour, polygon and holes in metres, area in m² (holes taken out), bounding size, roomType (room when absent, porch, deck or patio), floor.drop (step-down in metres, 0 when absent; an explicit floor.elevation takes precedence), porchFraming (auto, postSize, postSpacing in metres, beamSize, postCount and beamCount of existing generated parts; null when no outdoor/framing intent), and decking (boardSize, gap in metres, direction; resolved defaults for decks or when settings exist). auto follows porchFraming.auto; absent, on for a covered porch, off for decks/patios. false leaves framing to hand edits. These names and units match set_zone_intent. Includes the unit it belongs to (unitId and unit, its name; null: common area), and floor_choices: available floor plates (key, plateId, name, current; drawn and mezzanine flags). A room shares its floor plate with adjacent rooms unless detached. Persisted wall intent is wallMaterial (string, null when absent) and wallOverrides (wallId, geometric face a or b, finish; [] when absent), not a final rendered finish: local overrides and face paint can take precedence; absent intent is not a defect or a requirement to paint.

levelId.description: The level, by an id list_levels returned; an id made up from a name ("level_1", "level_ground") does not exist. Default: the floor the person is viewing, else the lowest floor.
